issues.desc: CHK-004 userSees requires that a project with only the old config filename still loads with a deprecation notice, but does not specify what the notice says, where it appears (stderr, log line, structured warning), or whether it is machine-parseable. Contrast with CHK-006, which now requires a CHANGELOG entry naming both aliases and replacements. CHK-004 could benefit from a similarly concrete notice specification, but this is advisory — the implementer can reasonably infer an appropriate format during PLAN.
